content:
maya: Quick design pass on the Private/VPC preflight flow — pushed a tiny prototype to the shared figma. Main asks: make probe feedback less noisy, improve copy for egress failures, and make error states keyboard-focusable.

leo: Saw the prototype, looks promising. Can we replace the modal toast spam with inline snackbars attached to each probe row? :thumbsup: 

olivia: +1 on snackbars. Also we need aria-live so screen readers announce probe updates. Prefer aria-live="polite" unless it's blocking.

dinesh: From infra side, snackbars are fine. One request: add a small inline "Retry" button per probe row that triggers a re-run without reloading the whole page. Avoid making users re-run the entire preflight.

maya: For copy, current failure text says "connectivity error" which is vague. Suggest: "Cannot reach Redwood controllers from this host. Check egress 443 to api.redwood.ai or use the manual upload option." Short + actionable.

leo: Agree. Also propose contextual help link "How to allow egress" that opens a panel with the simple curl test and a tcpcheck command.

dinesh: For the curl test, recommend we show an exact snippet users can copy:

```
# curl to validate egress
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health --connect-timeout 5
```

We can surface a small copy button.

olivia: A11y nit: any status icons need text equivalents and focus order should move to the retry button after a failure announcement. Use role="status" for ephemeral messages.

maya: UX question: should probe rows collapse after success to reduce clutter? Maybe collapse to a one-line summary with the green check and a "details" chevron.

leo: I like collapse, but keep a lightweight summary so users can still see the overall pass/fail at a glance. No animation that moves focus unexpectedly.

dinesh: Implementation detail: add exponential backoff on automatic retries (0, 2s, 6s, 18s) and stop after 4 attempts. Also throttle re-runs from UI to avoid spamming infra.

ui-bot: deploybot:preflight-checks: automated test run completed — failing on egress-probe for 10.2.0 image. See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4332

maya: Thanks. For error wording when probe times out: prefer "Connection timed out after 5s" instead of generic timeout. We should also suggest contacting infra with a diagnostic payload link.

leo: Small copy tweak for success: replace "All checks passed" with "Connectivity checks complete — ready to continue" to make next action clearer.

olivia: And ensure the primary continue button is disabled while any probe is running and has accessible label "Continue — checks in progress".

dinesh: I'll add the retry API endpoint: POST /api/v1/preflight/:id/retry and a websocket channel for incremental updates so UI doesn't poll.

maya: Great. I'll update the prototype with the inline snackbars, updated copy, collapse behavior, and the help panel with the curl snippet. Tagging @dinesh for API contract and @olivia for an a11y pass before we ship. :sparkles: 

leo: Thx — once updated can we run a quick lab with 5 non-technical folks to see if the retry copy is understood? Short moderated test (2–3 mins each).

maya: Yep. Scheduling that now. Thanks all!
